Hold US stocks for one year and 26% of the time you lost money. Hold them for twenty years and it was 0 of 53.

A model fitted on 1871 to 1950 said 3%.

It thought every year was independent. They were not. After a year that lost 10% or more, the next year gained 10.5% on average.

This is history, not advice.
